name: Typeahead
description:
A listbox at a caret or any rectangle, with focus staying in the text
(`aria-activedescendant`). Build it with `useTypeahead`; it needs no particular editor.
The result count is announced from a polite region that stays mounted (R20.9).

Width  two panes when `renderDetail` is given; below 28rem the detail moves under the list.
signature: <Item>({ state, anchor, label, renderItem, renderDetail, loading, empty, reserveRows, side, align, className, }: TypeaheadProps<Item>): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: anchor
props.description: What the list hangs from: an element, a caret rectangle or any rectangle.

props.name: empty
props.description: Text when there are no rows. Default "No results".

props.name: loading
props.description: Results are on their way. Reserve their room with `reserveRows`.

props.name: renderDetail
props.description: The highlighted row's detail, in a pane beside the list that moves under it in a narrow box.

props.name: renderItem
props.description: A row's content. Default: `OptionRow` from the item's `label`, `description`, `icon` and `meta`.

props.name: reserveRows
props.description: Hold this many rows of height from the start, for results that arrive late: the popup keeps its size and its place.
